opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jennifer Martin (employee ID E033) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E033.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Jennifer Martin (E033) is a full-time Analyst. She requested admin to Payroll, but Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so admin is not permitted. Maximum for full-time employees is write, so recommending write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for E033 shows contractor with basic training (note conflicts; security DB is authoritative). Contractors never get admin; with basic training max is read. Requested admin exceeds read, so recommending read.
reason: Jennifer Martin (E033) requested admin to Payroll. The Security record (noted as authoritative, conflicting with HR note) shows she is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors never receive admin; with basic training the maximum is read. Since the requested admin exceeds the maximum of read, grant read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee E033 Jennifer Martin requests admin access to Payroll.

HR note: role Analyst, employment type full_time, recommendation write.
Security note: role Analyst, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Security says security DB is authoritative and there is a conflict.

The policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system (Payroll owned by Payroll Specialist; Analyst doesn't own it).
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Conflict: HR says full_time, Security says contractor. The team memory says security DB is authoritative (per security note). So employment type = contractor, basic training.

For contractor with basic training: max is read. Requested admin > read, so grant read.

Let me submit decision: read.
